item.title: Top 5 Methods to Solve WebDriver Click Issues vs. JavaScript Click
item.description:
The Click Conundrum: Why JavaScript Click Works When WebDriver Click Fails

As a practitioner of automated testing with Selenium WebDriver, you might have stumbled upon a scenario where the conventional WebDriver click() method fails, while the JavaScript click method surprisingly succeeds. Why does this phenomenon occur, and what can you do about it? This detailed exploration will unravel the intricacies of click actions in Selenium, providing you with practical solutions and understanding to enhance your automation strategies.
